english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for joy or delight, especially delight at one's own good fortune.
This is the all-purpose noun for the joyful feeling at the heart of both senses, including pride and optimism when the context supplies them.
Use this more formal noun for the feeling of joy or delight itself, especially in written or elevated contexts.
Use this written noun for the inner feeling of intense happiness itself.
Use this for the joy or exultation felt after succeeding, rather than for the success itself.
